command:
cat > /root/ansible/ssh-host-cert/site.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Establish SSH host certificate authority and sign node1's host key
  hosts: ssh_hosts
  become: true
  vars:
    ca_dir: /etc/ssh/ca
    ca_key: /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_host_ca
    host_key: /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key
    host_cert: /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
    cert_validity: "+3650d"

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure CA directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ca_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Check if CA key already exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ ca_key }}"
      register: ca_key_stat

    - name: Generate SSH host certificate authority key pair
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >-
          ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f {{ ca_key }} -N ""
          -C "ssh-host-ca-{{ inventory_hostname }}"
      when: not ca_key_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Lock down CA private key permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ca_key }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0600"

    - name: Ensure ed25519 host key exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ host_key }}"
      register: host_key_stat

    - name: Fail if host key is missing
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "Host key {{ host_key }} not found; generate it before signing."
      when: not host_key_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Check if host certificate already exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ host_cert }}"
      register: host_cert_stat

    - name: Sign the host public key with the CA to produce a host certificate
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >-
          ssh-keygen -s {{ ca_key }}
          -I "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
          -h
          -n "{{ inventory_hostname }},{{ ansible_host }}"
          -V {{ cert_validity }}
          {{ host_key }}.pub
      when: not host_cert_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Ensure host certificate has correct ownership/permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ host_cert }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Configure sshd to present the signed host certificate
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^#?HostCertificate\s'
        line: "HostCertificate {{ host_cert }}"
        insertafter: EOF
      notify: Restart sshd

    - name: Ensure HostKey directive for the certified key is present
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^#?HostKey {{ host_key }}$'
        line: "HostKey {{ host_key }}"
        insertafter: EOF
      notify: Restart sshd

    - name: Validate sshd configuration
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: sshd -t
      changed_when: false

    - name: Fetch the CA public key to the control node
      ansible.builtin.fetch:
        src: "{{ ca_key }}.pub"
        dest: "/root/ansible/ssh-host-cert/fetched/{{ inventory_hostname }}/ssh_host_ca.pub"
        flat: true

  handlers:
    - name: Restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: ssh
        state: restarted
EOF
echo written
